sections.kicker: Prepared for Watchespedia by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a collector in the Gulf would on a first visit. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Watchespedia covers the best watches in the world. The front page does not yet say whose voice that is.
sections.keep: Your regional buying guides, like "Rolex Prices in Saudi Arabia 2026 | SAR Cost Guide". Nobody in the global press serves that reader this directly.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: Maximum Brilliance: The Franck Muller × Barbie™ Vintage Diamond-Diamond
pins.what: The first screen is a press release with the brand's own name on it.
pins.why: Every watch site runs the same launch news on the same day, so the lead story says nothing about why read it here.
pins.how: Open with what only Watchespedia says: your take, your region, your reader.
pins.label: Your lead story
pins.cost: Readers treat you as one more feed and leave for the brand's own page.

pins.quote: HOME E-SHOP WATCHES JEWELLERY LIFESTYLE BRANDS PORTRAITS PRESS
pins.what: The menu tries to be a shop, a magazine and a directory at once.
pins.why: When a site is everything, a reader cannot say in one line what it is for.
pins.how: Decide which of these is the brand and let the others sit under it.
pins.label: Your menu
pins.cost: The thing you are best at gets the same weight as the things you do on the side.

pins.what: Your most useful section is a list of links near the bottom.
pins.why: Prices in SAR and where to buy in Saudi Arabia and the UAE is the gap the global titles leave open.
pins.how: Make the Gulf buyer the center of the brand, not a footer block.
pins.label: Your gem
pins.cost: You keep competing with Hodinkee on their ground while your own ground sits unclaimed.

sections.intro: You said something is off and you cannot name it. I spent some time on your site. Here is my best attempt to name it.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Watchespedia's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Monocle, from another category. Its point of view on a city matters more than the news it reports.
